plugins.name: bytheslice
plugins.description: ByTheSlice runs your project like a grab-and-go pizza shop. v5 delivers in Pies (coherent chapters, usually 3 to 8 slices and fewer for a small app, one PR each) built from Slices (single deliverable units). Everyday loop: /sell-pie bakes a whole Pie autonomously, driving each slice through a context-separated build, test, verify and fix Workflow and committing per slice; at the pie boundary /box-it-up opens one PR, watches CI, and merges. /sell-slice is the high-touch single-slice loop. One-time prep: /setup-shop, /create-menu (PRD), /cook-pizzas (Pie/Slice roadmap; --repie migrates v4 checklists), /set-display-case (design system plus /library preview route), /final-quality-check (CI/E2E), /open-the-shop (credentials). The Library Preview Gate shows every user-visible component before it ships. Ships 52 registered subagents; in Claude Code all 52 run with enforced model tiers, tool allowlists and effort levels. The Pass, a Claude Code mod, draws a live pane and band beside the chat and warns when a delivery rule slips; nothing refuses a call, and the plugin keeps only the hooks it needs. /pizza-party builds a whole app end to end from a brief: one interview, then every pie with all gates local, one PR, a deploy to whatever host the operator has authorized and a URL. /open-kitchen opens a local read-only 3D kitchen (with --lobby, one page for every ByTheSlice project on the machine), /special-order adds features mid-flight, and /inspect-display audits the running app end to end.
